about: Answer key for the emails in this folder. tests/test_import.py parses every file listed here and checks the emails in it, then imports them into a running server. Generated fixtures come from tools/make_email_fixtures.py; scrubbed real emails come from tools/scrub_email.py (review them before committing). lane is where the email belongs; is_rfq says whether it asks for a quote.
